propositions: The complexity-baseline lock step executes four times per Verified change (once per OS/Python matrix cell) instead of once, wasting approximately 154 runner-seconds.
The lock is OS/Python-invariant (commit-level policy) with no platform or version-dependent behavior, so matrix duplication provides no incremental coverage.
Moving the unchanged lock invocation from jobs.test to jobs.lint preserves blocking semantics and policy coverage while eliminating duplicate work.
A workflow unit oracle must enforce exactly one lock invocation in the lint job and prohibit it from the test matrix to prevent regression.
Post-merge CI evidence shows the lock reduced from 211 aggregate runner-seconds to 5 runner-seconds per Verify run with unchanged fail-closed behavior.
